page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred text block with a woodcut ornament below the lines and the imprint at the foot. No margin text apart from handwritten annotations at top right, which are not printed.

main_text.l: Ad Augustum Imperatorem Romanorum, ac Reges, Principes, & Respublicas Europeas,
Pace Ecclesiastica constituenda, & Controversiis sopiendis. His subjiciuntur
Regum, Principum, & Rerum Publicarum ad Henricum Navarræ Regem RESPONSA

page.notes: Woodcut ornament between "Nunquam ante hac edita." and the imprint, not transcribed. Handwritten annotations at top right ("Rex Franciae" with a "IV" mark) are not printed and are left out. Black-letter style title; the title words "HENRICI" and "NAVARRORUM" are set in spaced capitals. Some letters in the scan are damaged, notably in "Ad Augustum" and "Pace Ecclesiastica", but they are legible as given.
